The capital of France is Paris.

An artistic concept inspired by late 18th-century Romanticism would center on a dramatic, moody landscape that evokes the sublime and the mysterious. The composition might feature a solitary figure standing on a precipice, gazing into a stormy, turbulent sky where jagged cliffs meet a churning sea. The color palette would rely on deep, contrasting tones—shadowy blues, charcoal grays, and flashes of eerie, ethereal light—to highlight the power of nature over human reason. This aesthetic rejects the rigid order of the Enlightenment, instead celebrating raw emotion, individualism, and the fantastical beauty found in the untamed wild.
